_comment: The lesson-block library, one entry per block. This is the ingest list for scripts/generate_blocks.js: add an entry here (or pass --list <file>) and re-run to grow the library. tag is the file name and registry key (Block_Tag style); category is one of Foundational | Assessment | Game | Utility. Groups as approved: basic -> Foundational, interactive -> Assessment, game -> Game, buttons -> Utility.

blocks.title: Data Table
blocks.description: A word data table exactly as it appears in a Word document: one semantic HTML table element (thead + tbody, tr/th/td) styled like a word-processor table - simple borders, a bold header row, plain text cells holding reference data in rows and columns. Display only - no buttons, no sorting, no filters, no interaction of any kind.

blocks.title: Normal Text Block
blocks.description: Normal text block with fonts and sizes: headings, paragraphs and emphasis — the readable prose primitive of a lesson.

blocks.title: Venn Diagram
blocks.description: A static two-circle Venn diagram with labeled regions showing where two groups overlap.

blocks.title: Steps Block
blocks.description: A numbered steps block laying a short procedure out in order.

blocks.title: Hook Dilemma
blocks.description: Split-card presenting two conflicting, plausible real-world choices to spark curiosity.

blocks.title: Hook StatShock
blocks.description: Single massive typographic statistic card with context revealing an unexpected reality.

blocks.title: Hook QuoteDissect
blocks.description: Historic or expert quote with highlighted buzzwords and clickable annotations.

blocks.title: Theory RuleCard
blocks.description: Clean definition box with a bolded 1-sentence anchor and 3 prerequisite bullet points.

blocks.title: Theory ContrastSplit
blocks.description: Side-by-side comparison column (e.g., "What it is" vs. "What it isn't").

blocks.title: Theory AnatomyCallout
blocks.description: SVG/diagram schematic where hovering or tapping parts reveals breakdown cards.

blocks.title: Theory FormulaBuilder
blocks.description: Visual equation box where variables have color-coded definitions underneath.

blocks.title: Theory TimelineSteps
blocks.description: Horizontal or vertical milestone progression showing chronological or logic order.

blocks.title: Theory TaxonomyTree
blocks.description: Collapsible node hierarchy classifying concepts from broad family to specific instance.

blocks.title: Theory PerspectiveShift
blocks.description: Tabbed card showing how two different stakeholders view the exact same event.

blocks.title: Memory MnemonicAnchor
blocks.description: Visual badge isolating an acronym, rhyme, or spatial pattern to aid memory.

blocks.title: Memory CheatSheet
blocks.description: Compact key-value matrix summarizing all relevant rules for reference.

blocks.title: Context HistoricalPivot
blocks.description: Short story card showing the exact crisis or problem that caused the rule to be invented.

blocks.title: Context RealWorldScope
blocks.description: Micro-case study illustrating where this rule directly affects money, safety, or code.

blocks.title: Concept ScaleZoom
blocks.description: Stepped slider zooming from micro view to macro ecosystem view.

blocks.title: Concept JargonBuster
blocks.description: Sentence with underlined technical terms that reveal plain-English definitions on hover.

blocks.title: Concept BeforeAfter
blocks.description: Interactive split image/text card comparing a raw flawed state to an optimized state.

blocks.title: Concept PrincipleMatrix
blocks.description: 2x2 grid sorting ideas by two axes (e.g., High Impact vs. Low Effort).

blocks.title: Concept SpectrumBar
blocks.description: Continuous gradient bar pinning concepts along a spectrum (e.g., Informal to Formal).

blocks.title: Concept AudioWave
blocks.description: Short audio player paired with synced sentence highlights for pronunciation or rhetoric.

blocks.title: Concept StepLadder
blocks.description: Progressive stack where higher-order rules visually sit atop foundational rules.

blocks.title: Concept CautionFlag
blocks.description: Warning box detailing strict exceptions, non-examples, and illegal rule transfers.

blocks.title: Concept AnalogyBridge
blocks.description: Split card comparing the abstract academic rule directly to everyday physical objects.

blocks.title: Concept FlowDiagram
blocks.description: Static clean SVG flowchart mapping decision paths from condition to resolution.

blocks.title: Concept TakeawayBadge
blocks.description: Single high-contrast summary banner marking the conclusion of an exposition sequence.

blocks.title: XRay
blocks.description: Click the term to highlight its location in the sentence or equation.

blocks.title: Multiple Choice Question
blocks.description: Multiple choice question with four options and instant right/wrong feedback.

blocks.title: Text Fill Out Question
blocks.description: Text fill-out question where the learner types the answer and checks it.

blocks.title: Recall BinarySwipe
blocks.description: Tinder-style left/right card swipe sorting statements into "Valid" or "Invalid".

blocks.title: Recall SpeedPick
blocks.description: 4-choice multiple choice question with an animated countdown dial for rapid fluency.

blocks.title: Recall FillTheBlank
blocks.description: Prose text with inline dropdown selects to complete sentences grammatically or logically.

blocks.title: Recall MultiSelect
blocks.description: Question requiring user to identify all 2 or 3 correct answers before continuing.

blocks.title: Recall RankSort
blocks.description: Vertical draggable list requiring users to place items into the correct hierarchical order.

blocks.title: Trap CommonError
blocks.description: A tricky question targeting the #1 typical student mistake, revealing why intuition failed.

blocks.title: Trap SpotTheLie
blocks.description: Four statements displayed on screen where the student must click the single fabricated premise.

blocks.title: Trap OverconfidenceCheck
blocks.description: Confidence slider (0-100%) paired with a quiz choice to measure calibration.

blocks.title: Interact ClickToReveal
blocks.description: Obscured blurred answer cards that clear when tapped to promote self-testing.

blocks.title: Interact CategorySort
blocks.description: Two or three buckets where user drags mixed items into proper classifications.

blocks.title: Interact WordBankMatch
blocks.description: Draggable chips matched to empty slots in a diagram or argument structure.

blocks.title: Interact ErrorHighlighter
blocks.description: Paragraph of text where the user must tap the exact words containing errors.

blocks.title: Interact SliderEstimate
blocks.description: Number slider where the user guesses a quantitative value before seeing the truth.

blocks.title: Interact DialThreshold
blocks.description: Rotary dial requiring the user to tune a variable into the optimal safe operating zone.

blocks.title: Interact HotspotPin
blocks.description: Image/canvas asset where user clicks the specific region matching a technical prompt.

blocks.title: Interact CodeBugFinder
blocks.description: Compact code editor snippet where tapping a line flags syntax or logic flaws.

blocks.title: Interact TermConnect
blocks.description: Canvas string/line drawing connecting terms on the left to definitions on the right.

blocks.title: Interact TrueFalseMatrix
blocks.description: Compact table with a grid of radio buttons testing 4 related propositions at once.

blocks.title: Interact ArgumentDeconstruct
blocks.description: Blocks representing Claim, Reason, and Evidence that snap into an engine rack.

blocks.title: Interact ScrubNumber
blocks.description: Inline bold number inside a paragraph that can be scrubbed horizontally to mutate text.

blocks.title: Interact MatrixToggle
blocks.description: Logic grid where clicking cells cycles through Yes, No, or Neutral states.

blocks.title: Interact SyllogismTester
blocks.description: Two premises shown where user must select the only valid deductive conclusion.

blocks.title: Interact SentenceScramble
blocks.description: Jumbled phrase chips that must be clicked in sequence to build a coherent thought.

blocks.title: Interact Elimination
blocks.description: Question where clicking an option crosses it out, narrowing down to the last valid answer.

blocks.title: Interact HintLadder
blocks.description: Question card with 3 progressive hints; reveals cost score points if used.

blocks.title: Interact PredictionCard
blocks.description: User commits to a prediction before an interactive video or animation plays out.

blocks.title: Interact RubricScore
blocks.description: User grades a sample student essay or problem using a mini clickable rubric.

blocks.title: Interact FactOrInference
blocks.description: Rapid-fire categorizer marking statements as either observed data or assumptions.

blocks.title: Interact VennDiagram
blocks.description: Overlapping 2-circle graphic where items must be placed into Group A, Group B, or Both.

blocks.title: Interact FormulaInput
blocks.description: Structured math keypad input block validating numeric or algebraic equivalence.

blocks.title: Game CantileverBalance
blocks.description: Two-sided balance arm where correct answers or evidence add weight to keep it level.

blocks.title: Game TugOfWar
blocks.description: Two opposing teams; answering correctly pulls the rope toward the student's anchor flag.

blocks.title: Game TicTacToe
blocks.description: 3x3 grid; claiming any space requires answering a question; AI plays counter-moves.

blocks.title: Game ConnectFour
blocks.description: 7x6 board where answering correctly drops a colored token into a column to get 4 in a row.

blocks.title: Game BlackjackThreshold
blocks.description: Draw cards representing values/concepts to reach 21 without busting on distractors.

blocks.title: Game HangmanGallows
blocks.description: Guessing conceptual keywords letter-by-letter or clue-by-clue before chances run out.

blocks.title: Game FreeThrow
blocks.description: Basketball hoop canvas; answering accurately triggers a clean swish; errors bounce off the rim.

blocks.title: Game DuckHunt
blocks.description: Moving target ducks on canvas; user taps the target carrying the correct term or answer.

blocks.title: Game CircuitBreaker
blocks.description: Connect parallel/series wires by selecting the correct components to power a bulb.

blocks.title: Game HazardSweeper
blocks.description: Grid board where students uncover safe proof tiles while flagging fallacious landmines.

blocks.title: Game TowerDefense
blocks.description: Answering questions deploys defensive turrets that stop incoming error waves.

blocks.title: Game ConveyorSorter
blocks.description: Items move along a factory conveyor; user toggles track switches to guide them to bins.

blocks.title: Game PipelinePlumber
blocks.description: Rotate pipe segments by answering correctly to create a continuous water flow.

blocks.title: Game SpaceDocking
blocks.description: Tune retro-thrusters using vector inputs to dock a spacecraft into a station module.

blocks.title: Game ElevatorWeight
blocks.description: Manage elevator payload capacities by solving proportional distribution math.

blocks.title: Game MemoryMatch
blocks.description: Grid of facedown tiles; flip pairs that share a concept and its practical application.

blocks.title: Game VaultCracker
blocks.description: 3-digit combination lock solved by answering 3 sequential logic riddles.

blocks.title: Game CrosswordMini
blocks.description: Compact 5x5 crossword grid populated entirely with the lesson's key vocabulary.

blocks.title: Game CardBattler
blocks.description: Play cards with power stats determined by the logical strength of arguments against a bot.

blocks.title: Game AsteroidBlaster
blocks.description: Retro space canvas where typing or clicking the correct answer shoots an approaching rock.

blocks.title: Game AuctionBidder
blocks.description: Place valuation bids on assets based on evaluating incomplete balance sheets.

blocks.title: Game EscapeRoom
blocks.description: 3 sequential interactive scenes where finding clues requires solving topic puzzles.

blocks.title: Game WhackAMole
blocks.description: Moles pop up labeled with valid terms and distractors; tap only the valid terms.

blocks.title: Game RhythmTap
blocks.description: Tap falling notes in time with structural cadence (e.g., poetic meter or timing loops).

blocks.title: Game LaserMirror
blocks.description: Position reflective mirrors on a grid to bounce an optical beam into the target node.

blocks.title: Btn 3DTactile
blocks.description: Neumorphic, physical push button with distinct 3D depressed travel and click sound.

blocks.title: Btn PillToggle
blocks.description: Segmented horizontal pill switch for flipping states (e.g., "Beginner" vs. "Advanced").

blocks.title: Btn HoldToConfirm
blocks.description: Long-press button requiring a 1.5-second hold with circular fill gauge to submit.

blocks.title: Btn SplitAction
blocks.description: Dual-action button (primary action on left, dropdown options menu on right).

blocks.title: Btn Destructive
blocks.description: High-contrast safety button with a double-tap confirmation pattern (e.g., "Reset Run").

blocks.title: Btn RevealDrawer
blocks.description: Bottom or side slide-out drawer trigger for accessing formulas and toolbars.

blocks.title: Tool Scratchpad
blocks.description: Freeform canvas overlay enabling drawing, calculating, or handwriting directly on screen.

blocks.title: Tool UnitConverter
blocks.description: Embedded floating calculator converting metric, imperial, or currency units.

blocks.title: Tool GlossaryModal
blocks.description: Quick-search dictionary overlay searching definitions without leaving the lesson.

blocks.title: Tool CaseWorkbench
blocks.description: Split-pane layout with source text on the left and an annotation ledger on the right.

blocks.title: Tool FormulaSheet
blocks.description: Slide-over quick reference panel displaying foundational equations.

blocks.title: Nav StickyProgress
blocks.description: Pinned top progress bar showing current lesson position and score accumulation.

blocks.title: Nav CheckpointJump
blocks.description: Clickable breadcrumb dots allowing jumping back to previously completed sections.

blocks.title: Nav BranchPath
blocks.description: Two-path decision junction allowing the student to choose their learning path forward.

blocks.title: Feedback ToastSuccess
blocks.description: Lightweight sliding notification banner verifying correct input with haptic vibration.

blocks.title: Feedback ModalDiagnostic
blocks.description: Full overlay breaking down why an answer failed and presenting an analogy.

blocks.title: State StreakCelebration
blocks.description: Confetti trigger component activating on 5 consecutive correct recall checks.

blocks.title: State ReviewLocker
blocks.description: End-of-lesson card holding all missed questions for review before concluding.
